lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What do you usually like to do?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我喜欢看书、听音乐、还喜欢跑步。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān kànshū, tīng yīnyuè, hái xǐhuān pǎobù.
lines.english: I like reading, listening to music, and also running.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 不，一周跑三次。周末有时候打篮球。
lines.pinyin: Bù, yī zhōu pǎo sān cì. Zhōumò yǒushíhou dǎ lánqiú.
lines.english: No, three times a week. Weekends sometimes play basketball.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What kind of books do you read?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 喜欢看历史书和中文故事书。
lines.pinyin: Xǐhuān kàn lìshǐ shū hé Zhōngwén gùshì shū.
lines.english: Like reading history books and Chinese story books.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 真有意思！我也想学中文。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn yǒuyìsi! Wǒ yě xiǎng xué Zhōngwén.
lines.english: Really interesting! I also want to learn Chinese.
